scientific_integrity: A self-contained cyclic-edge classification proves every move count for all n; exhaustive Python and independent C++ implementations corroborate finite cases. No independent audit has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: Exact partition projection for simple bipartite 2-regular graphs, n>=2; no mixing-time or spectral-gap assertion. Preexisting total-state enumeration and connectivity are credited. Finite exhaustive checks n<=6; potential differently worded prior cycle-splitting kernel remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact cycle-partition lumping for bipartite degree-two switch walks
